set.body:
Use the audit's proposed default. Keep the accepted deposit intact and admit the curated BIDS result as a separate linked dataset through the normal workflow.

Acceptance criteria

1. Reproduce the valid archive-to-BIDS draft that repeats ReassessmentRequired after accepting reassessment. Return an actionable transition outcome and document it accurately.
2. A curator accepts a new BIDS collection linked to the exact source archive release with permitted provenance. The source remains byte-identical and the new result has explicit local custody and access.
3. A result-only recipient cannot learn restricted source identity or metadata through the linkage. Denied and interrupted creation cannot publish an unreviewed result.
4. Unchanged-content reassessment and normal same-kind additions still pass. The new workflow terminates after ordinary review.

Verification

Paired archive/BIDS fixture on both catalogs with old-release hashes and separate-source-disclosure assertions.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: PRO03: Preserve an archive and link its reviewed BIDS curation
